note: One tab button of the admin window, instantiated once per registered pane into TabStrip. The script renames the root to 'tab:<id>' and writes the caption into OZ_VppTabText, so both names are a contract with OZ_VppMenu.c. A button ROOT holds page content instead of the Edge/Bg/Text idiom a nested button gets, so the three children are written out here -- with the names that idiom would have given them.

panel.name: OZ_VppTabEdge
panel.note: One unit outside the button on every side: vpp.tab (150x28) plus two.

label.name: OZ_VppTabText
label.note: Empty: the caption is the pane's label, set by RegisterPane; ShowPane recolours it accent for the open tab and muted for the rest.
